title: Real rooms across the reference repos
description: Every room that exists in any of the four setups, with the repo it came from and the files that name it. This file is the evidence base for `room_types.yaml`: a room type's `source_rooms` are drawn from here, so a type that no real room produced cannot be recorded, and the corroboration rule for `default: true` can be checked by joining through this file rather than by trusting a comment.

name.description: The room as the repo spells it. Kept verbatim, including a non-English name: this is the record of what exists, and normalising it here would destroy the evidence the room-type map is derived from.

repo.description: The repository's owner handle, lowercased, as `licenses.yaml` and `inventory.json` name it. One record per room per repo, so a room two setups both have is two records and the corroboration join counts two repos.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths of every selected file the room was read from, sorted. A list rather than one path because a room is ordinarily spread across a package directory, a dashboard and its helpers; every entry names the room and every selected file that names the room is an entry, which `tools/catalog/rooms.py` re-derives and enforces.
